title: 43 And it is He Who causes laughter and causes weeping. NecessityOfSaintlyGuide
body:
Sura 54 Al-Qamar

1 The Hour (of Judgment) is near and the moon is split. LessonForDisobedientPeople WordOfHaqq
15 Fahal Min Muddakirin. Gibt es irgendjemanden, der daran denkt? PunishmentOfTheGrave
17 Hal Min Mudhdhakirin. AttributesOfDogs RequiredKnowledge
15, 17, 22, 32, 40, 51 And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember. StudyOfHolyQuran
42 They will be taken with the grasp of the Mighty. BatshaRabbika
45 Sayuhzamu Al-Jam`u Wa Yuwalluna Ad- Dubura. MessageToKurds MessageToTheKing

Sura 55 Ar-Rahman

1-2 (God) Most Gracious! It is He Who has taught the Qur'an. AlBayan DontBlameAllah
3 He created Man. AlBayan PeakOfCivilization SajdaForAdam TeachingOfTheDove
4 He has taught him Al Bayan. (He taught him clear speech) AlBayan SajdaForAdam TeachingOfTheDove
6 The stars & the trees prostrate. AlBayan
7-9 And He has set up the Balance, that you may not transgress (due) balance, but observe the measure with equity and do not
fall short of it. DontBlameAllah DrunknessAndHeavenlyBalance SendUsASavior

WayOfHonor

29 On Him depends all creatures in the Heavens and on Earth; [and] everyday He manifests Himself in yet another
[wondrous] way. ComeToFellowship

33 O ye assembly of Jinns and men! If it be ye can pass beyond the zones of the heavens and the earth, pass ye! not without
authority shall ye be able to pass. ExceptBySultan HaqiqatAndMalakoot ManCannotLeadMan

PrinceRajaAshman TalibulIlmi
